group_definition: Positive compact categories in the input coarse mask, and separately in the actual central-half coarse tile observations used for feature selection. Compact zero is ignore, not a group. RINGS valid outside-tumour is a positive compact category and counts as a task group.
field_definition: Geometric capacity of complete disjoint 224-pixel fields in the original unpadded working image at its frozen encoder base sampling, anchored to the frozen image hash. This is not a claim of statistical independence or a count of extra optical information. Do not qualify a rejected field by padding, overlap, repeated tokens, or arbitrary upsampling; a sampling change requires a new geometry audit retaining this eligibility anchor.
coarse_observation_definition: Use coarse_tile_observations unchanged: tile size90, at least80% of the full side on both axes, at least95% one positive category, and at least one token centre in the central half on each axis.
rare_group_policy: No extra per-group minimum beyond one usable tile. Report counts per group; do not drop a rare group, an absent coarse class in the reference, or difficult positive pixels to improve scores.
excluded_handling: Excluded images remain archived and visible only in a separate diagnostics inventory. They are absent from the prospective benchmark PLAN, quality denominator, runtime denominator and method ranking.
history: Cycles1-10 and their signed scores are unchanged. The 4x4 field and16 coarse-tile cutoffs are prospective engineering eligibility rules, not validated biological or statistical sample-size requirements. Re-establish a matched parent baseline on the qualified scope.
